The annotated candidate has been saved to `answer.json`.

The solution keeps every original C token unchanged and all original assertions intact. It:
- Preserves the existing `requires size >= 1;` function contract and adds `assigns \nothing;`
- Adds a single `/*@ ... */` loop annotation block for the `while` loop with:
  - `loop invariant 1 <= i <= size+1`
  - `loop invariant sn == i-1` (which forces `sn == size` at loop exit)
  - `loop assigns i, sn`
  - `loop variant size + 1 - i`

These invariants establish that after the loop `sn == size`, so the `if(sn != size)` branch is dead and the `assert(sn == 0)` is vacuously valid. No admit/assume/axiom was used.
